settings.useBackground.label: Show widget background
settings.useBackground.desc: Off = wallpaper shows through; on = solid color behind the widget.
settings.useThemeColor.label: Use Noctalia theme color
settings.useThemeColor.desc: Off = the orange default below; on = recolor with your current Noctalia accent.
settings.scale.label: Widget scale
settings.scale.desc: Multiplier for the base 1180×600 layout. 0.5–2.0 is sensible.
settings.accent.label: Accent color (hex, used when theme color is off)
settings.hot.label: Alert / hot color (hex)
settings.bg.label: Background color (hex, used when background is on)
settings.updateMs.label: Update interval (ms)
settings.disks.label: Disks (comma-separated mount points)
settings.iface.label: Network interface (blank = mode below)
settings.netMode.label: Network mode (sum | auto)
settings.netMode.desc: sum = add all non-loopback interfaces; auto = pick busiest
settings.gpuScript.label: GPU info script (JSON output)
settings.gpuScript.desc: Path to a script printing JSON with a 'tooltip' field containing 'Temperature: NN°C' and optionally 'Utilization: NN%'.
settings.cpuMax.label: CPU max safe temp (°C)
settings.gpuMax.label: GPU max safe temp (°C)
settings.ssdMax.label: SSD max safe temp (°C)
settings.starCount.label: Scope star count
